actions.message:
Commands
/res - respawn
/credits - sprites, sound and people

/shop - buy items
/title - change your title
/changeteam - swaps team, use only when players in both teams are unequal
/practice, /pvp and /1v1 - swaps to Practice Mode, PvP mode and 1v1 mode, in order

actions.comment: when a player leaves, destroy all units owned by that player

then.text: It's a wonderful day outside, isn't it?
With magic and spells I come!
My power meter - full! Prepare to be wasted!
Hm! I see! I hear! Yet dark! Very good!
Calculating Commander come at your Careless Command!
When this is done, I want to fly a kite.
